spec_case: issue #682: record_children still pins the score trigger's child after a chunk fails under run_as_is
description: decompose-execution-failed's own companion with runtime.state.record_children on: chunk x's own model call fails, the decomposition fails as execution_failed and the source prompt dispatches whole (the default on_failure: run_as_is) -- but the plan's own chunk x the child run did get to before failing is still grafted onto the node.
